## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; key ratios (VXX, SPY/TLT, HYG/LQD) are neutral, giving no clear directional signal. SPY (1W: +3.06% | 1M: -0.14%) ↑ rising RECOVERY and XLF (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +10.75%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND provide mixed confirmation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -11.60%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit mild improvement: HYG (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +0.70%) → flat ABOVE TREND; stocks vs bonds mixed with SPY RECOVERY and TLT (1W: -1.83% | 1M: +0.53%) ↓ falling CORRECTION.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-slightly-looser. UUP (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +1.65%) ↓ falling CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -1.83% | 1M: +0.53%) ↓ falling CORRECTION show mixed duration flows while HYG ABOVE TREND signals tame credit spread.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals showing strength: XLF (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +10.75%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and XLI (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +6.88%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -6.34%) ↑ rising RECOVERY; style: cyclicals/value showing relative strength, growth mixed.

5. US vs Global?
US led the week: SPY (1W: +3.06% | 1M: -0.14%) ↑ rising RECOVERY vs EEM (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -2.86%) → flat RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +2.85% | 1M: -7.90%) ↑ rising RECOVERY — EM/China participation but lagging monthly.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Elevated speculative flows: ARKK (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +6.97%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +6.71% | 1M: -2.38%) ↑ rising RECOVERY; small caps mixed with IWM (1W: -0.31% | 1M: +4.15%) → flat CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Mixed commodity signal: CPER (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -4.01%) ↑ rising RECOVERY while precious metals are recovering — GLD (1W: +2.27% | 1M: -6.31%) ↑ rising RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +5.31% | 1M: -15.25%) ↑ rising RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -8.85%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -25.95%) → flat BELOW TREND; UNG (1W: -1.35% | 1M: +0.00%) ↓ falling NEUTRAL.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLF (1W & 1M positive) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +23.98%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND show durable leadership. Major divergence across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, TLT show 1W ≠ 1M) signals a transitional market and tempers strong directional calls.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and select high-beta exposure (XLF (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +10.75%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +23.98%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to energy beta (XLE (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -8.85%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND); monitor tech momentum (XLK (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -6.34%) ↑ rising RECOVERY).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +10.75%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; Biotech XBI (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +23.98%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -8.85%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; Real Estate XLRE (1W: -2.10% | 1M: +2.68%) ↓ falling CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Gold GLD (1W: +2.27% | 1M: -6.31%) ↑ rising RECOVERY and Copper CPER (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -4.01%) ↑ rising RECOVERY. BEARISH: Brent/Crude BNO (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -25.95%) → flat BELOW TREND and USO (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -25.92%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (fear complacency reference), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value posture pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, core ratios neutral with mixed confirmations across equities and credit. Financials and cyclicals showing strength (XLF, XBI), while tech momentum and duration (XLK, TLT) divergence is the key risk to monitor.
